replacements.Un repositorio común y una revisión base: A shared repository and base revision feed two worktrees with their own HEAD, index, and dirty state. Each task runs behind an independent sandbox boundary controlling filesystem, network, processes, and identity. Network effects cross that boundary toward external resources. Both tasks can still collide on an external resource unless it is namespaced per task. Candidate commits converge again at integration; if integration changes the SHA, evidence bound to the previous SHA must be invalidated and rerun.
